name: fft-analysis-agent
description: Analyze MATLAB and oscilloscope signals with the FFT Analysis Tools API, including harmonics and THD.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze signal FFT, harmonics, and THD in MATLAB.
interface.longDescription: Runs the FFT Analysis Tools non-GUI MATLAB API for MAT files, oscilloscope CSV files, and workspace signals, then explains fundamental, harmonic, and THD results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze a MAT or oscilloscope CSV signal and explain its FFT, harmonics, and THD.
